text:
Incident Bot: automated alert — pager fired: latency_p99 > 1200ms on /v1/generate in eu-west; SLO burn 18% over 5m window. Trigger: pd_incident_5721.
PagerDuty: page sent to rotation (sasha).
Sasha (oncall): ack — I'm looking now. First pass: stop batching on hot paths and divert non-critical traffic to fallback model.
Miguel: logs show a sudden fanout from a partner endpoint, lots of concurrent small requests. p95 also creeping up. Not seeing errors, just long queue times on sidecars.
Carla: checking infra — autoscaler couldn't provision more GPU nodes in eu-west due to regional quota spike (GCP GPU quota). We can either failover to eu-central or use dedicated-fallback pool.
Sasha (oncall): plan: 1) set routing policy -> prefer eu-central and dedicated-fallback for non-enterprise tenants. 2) reduce batch_window to 10ms for /v1/generate to cut queue tail. 3) warm KV cache after divert. 4) notify product support for customer impact. Executing now.
Ops Bot: executing route change: infra-cli route update --service api-gen --region-preference eu-central,eu-west --fallback-model redwood-small-1 --dry-run=false
Ops Bot: reduced batch window: runtime-config set /v1/generate batch_window_ms=10
Miguel: restarting batcher sidecar on affected pods to apply config: kubectl rollout restart deployment/batcher-sidecar -n inference-eu-west
Product Support: flagged top 3 affected customers (acct-451, acct-902, acct-718). Reached out to acct-451 via DM; they report timeouts for large-batch jobs.
Sasha (oncall): manual traffic reroute in progress. ETA ~45s for new routing to take effect. If p99 doesn't drop in 2m we will toggle model fallback globally for anonymous/free traffic.
Carla: spun up 2 nodes in eu-central and registered them with the pool — infra shows increased capacity. Quota request for eu-west submitted but slow.
Miguel: KV cache warm script running (replaying recent prefixes) to reduce cold starts: 
```
python tools/cache_warm.py --region eu-central --service api-gen --window 10m
```
Incident Bot: update: p99 now 980ms (down from 1350ms) in eu-west; burn dropped to 7%.
Product Support: sending temporary customer advisory to affected accounts: "We're aware of elevated generation latency in EU regions and routing some workloads to fallback capacity. Minimal impact expected; we're monitoring."
Sasha (oncall): quick checklist for handoff: actions taken + commands run + affected accounts. Will hand off to Lina in 30m — Lina please pick up followups and coordinate with infra to get eu-west quota resolved.
Lina (night): ack — I'll take it. Please add any remaining runbook items.
Miguel: note for postmortem — partner burst pattern: many small requests from one partner token; consider rate-limiting or token-level throttle to avoid saturating GPU queues.
Carla: follow-up tasks for morning: 1) escalate GPU quota with cloud provider 2) increase dedicated-fallback capacity 3) add automated failover route test.
Sasha (oncall): thanks everyone. :thumbsup: Logs + commands included in incident ticket PD-5721. I'll update the ticket with timeline and handoff notes.
Incident Bot: thread closed by sasha at 1812233610 — monitoring continues.
